Rules / Maintainability

SK7030 File length exceeds the configured threshold

A file contains more physical lines than dotnet_code_quality.SK7030.threshold (default 1000).

CategoryMaintainability
Default severityhint
ScopeSyntax
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseyes
Cached per fileyes
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since1.3

Why

File length is a coarse review signal, not a claim that the code is incorrect. The deliberately broad 1000-line default is a configurable starting policy, not a measurement calibrated to this repository or a universal design limit. Comments, blank lines and inactive preprocessor text count. A terminal empty line after the final newline does not count; an empty file has zero lines. Splitting a file requires design judgment, so there is no automatic fix.

Example

Instead of:

// A file with 1001 physical lines at the default threshold.

Write:

// A file at or below its configured threshold, or an explicitly scoped higher limit.

When it does not fire

This is an exact physical-line measurement, not executable statement count. LF, CRLF and CR line endings have identical counting semantics. Generated files are excluded using Roslyn's normal generated-code policy. Missing, malformed, zero, negative or overflowing thresholds fall back to 1000, matching the other metrics. Only counts strictly greater than the threshold are reported. The diagnostic carries skala.metric.value.

Configuration

  • dotnet_code_quality.SK7030.threshold
  • dotnet_diagnostic.SK7030.severity
